nodes.text: @KierstenWarren I did a quick search: the weird pneumonia - it has a name: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) and another dangerous out break in that region of the world, Nipah virus. Infected animals contaminate food supply. Also Zika spread by mosquitoes but I read that symptoms are mild if at all.
